dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-body section toward the visible posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: A prominent asymmetrical indentation is visible on the left lateral margin posterior to the head region; a less pronounced indentation exists on the corresponding right margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white median intensity with a prominent blue-to-purple chromatic shift at the periphery.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the high-reflectance dorsal center and the lower-reflectance lateral margins.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Deep transverse crease or indentation on the left side behind the blowhole; longitudinal shadow-casting crease on the right posterior peduncle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, dark vertical linear feature is visible on the right lateral side of the posterior peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast, circular dark blowhole aperture located at the anterior dorsal apex.
